scope: Acceptance of the five sampled motion criteria only; not full art approval or a continuous-performance assessment.

impact_recognition.evidence: White player silhouette at 0.1 and 0.2 seconds remains unambiguous within the cyan ring; normal material returns by 0.4. Hull drops 35 to 27%. Small orange hit is clearly distinct from the larger filled yellow/orange fireball at 1 second.
impact_recognition.limitation: Persistent ring is a location cue rather than hit feedback; its constant appearance does not prevent recognition of the white flash.

smoke_fading.evidence: Initial hit dwindles to sparse sparks by 0.4–0.6. Large burst at 1 second disperses to faint smoke and small embers by 1.5, with no bright fire at 2–3. Damaged aircraft continues emitting a thin curved trail.
smoke_fading.limitation: Connected trail resembles a granular chain, lacks soft volumetric breakup, and partly merges with fine dark water. Disappearance against texture can resemble fading.

wake_continuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes stay attached to sterns and taper outward across all visible sampled positions.
wake_continuity.limitation: Repeated oval segments remain evident; connected placement passes but foam material lacks convincing turbulence.

camera_motion.evidence: Player approaches tracking center then remains tracked throughout the turn. Cyan circle remains centered on player at every timestamp; no sampled jumps or detached cue.
camera_motion.limitation: Sparse timestamps cannot establish interpolation smoothness or micro-jitter.

control_visibility.evidence: Bomb and Fire stay fixed and legible. Escort behind Bomb at 3 seconds does not obscure label. Hull, heat and objectives remain readable. Ring improves player location while crossing deck at 0.4–0.6.
control_visibility.limitation: Hawk label still intersects minimap edge at 2 seconds. Aircraft material partly merges with deck despite clearer location.

remaining_priorities: Improve smoke and wake materials beyond repeated granular/oval stamps.
Reduce fine water contrast to support faint effects.
Improve aircraft-to-deck contrast inside the useful player ring.
Prevent ally labels entering minimap and test dense combat motion separately.
limitations: Actually inspected all 18 PNGs and motion.json event timestamps. No source/key read. No actual phone FPS inference from simulation timing. Shoreline material change not covered by this water-only motion sequence.
